panels.title: Durable business history vs ephemeral ops metrics

options.content: **RFC-0001 D5 boundary:** Prometheus is not backfilled -- its panels (e.g. the `Analytics Ingest` dashboard) show data only since the stack last started. **This dashboard queries `postgres-analytics` directly** (the `Analytics Postgres` Grafana datasource, `event_buckets`/`current_items`/`seed_marker`) and is the durable business-data history: seeded events written through the live ingestion path (`analytics seed`, ADR-0003) join seamlessly with live traffic -- a panel spanning the seam (`now-30d -> now+1h`) shows no discontinuity. "Ops metrics are ephemeral, business data is durable." Vertical red markers are the 3 seeded story anomalies (`seed-anomaly` tag, written by `analytics seed` at seed time).

panels.title: Events per Hour by Type
panels.description: sum(count) from event_buckets, grouped by hour and event_type (created|deleted only, RFC-0001 Phase 5 D5 by-type seam -- the backend has no PUT endpoint, so no live-traffic EVENT_TYPE_UPDATED ever exists to seed a lookalike for). Default range is 30d so seeded history and live traffic sit in the same panel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_start,'1h'),
  event_type AS metric,
  sum(count) AS value
FROM event_buckets
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
GROUP BY 1, event_type
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily Totals
panels.description: sum(count) from event_buckets, grouped by day (all event types combined) -- the coarse-grained business-volume view over the same 30d default range as the by-type panel above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_start,'1d'),
  sum(count) AS value
FROM event_buckets
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: current_items: Live vs Tombstoned
panels.description: current_items is reconciled STATE (ADR-0002 snapshot + stream), not an event_buckets aggregate: live = tombstoned_at IS NULL, tombstoned = tombstoned_at IS NOT NULL. A single-row query; Grafana renders one stat tile per returned column.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tombstoned_at IS NULL) AS live,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tombstoned_at IS NOT NULL) AS tombstoned
FROM current_items

panels.title: Seed Marker
panels.description: The seed_marker row (RFC-0001 Phase 5 D5): parameters of the most recently completed `analytics seed` run, backing GET /api/v1/seed-marker -- the same contract loadgen's scale guard checks at startup (Phase 5 PR-2). Empty table means no seed run has ever completed on this stack.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  scale,
  days,
  seed,
  to_timestamp(ref_unix) AS ref_time,
  seeded_at,
  events_written
FROM seed_marker
WHERE id = 1
